interpretation: Eighteen of 26 batches (69.23%) in this bounded current-generation sample had no inference requests.
No all-excluded plan/result pair shared a PostgreSQL xmin in this baseline; each was persisted in separate transactions.
The timing statistic is recorded observation-to-result-completedAt, not durable commit acknowledgement or order latency.
The sample is descriptive and does not establish a causal speedup, trading edge, or profitability.
All-excluded admission can complete evidence for exclusion reasons that still cannot authorize a no-entry decision; decision eligibility is unchanged.
